thread:
Jo (CSM): Heads-up: Orion QBR scheduled for Wed 10am. Need a tight 12-slide deck: health, adoption, roadmap, renewal ask. Who can own which?
Maya (CS): I can own the health + ask slide. Will need data pulls from Ravi and a one-line "why it matters" for execs.
Ravi (CS): I'll take adoption + onboarding flows. Current numbers: 68% seats active, weekly DAU +8% MoM, 4 blocked integrations (SFTP, SCIM, webhooks, reporting). SFTP workaround available but not yet GA.
Lina (Finance): Heads-up from finance: likely pressure on price at renewal. Model two scenarios: (A) retention-focused (no discount, add services) (B) renewal guardrail (15% discount + committed usage).
Diego (Enablement): I ran two cohort workshops. Top friction: unclear success milestones and missing customer playbook. I'll draft two role-based playbooks and paste top quotes in the doc.
Jo (CSM): Also want a short "churn signal" slide: top 3 indicators and current status. Maya, can you pick the cutoff thresholds?
Maya (CS): Sure. Propose: low risk <3 signals, medium 3-5, high 6+. Will add color coding.
Ravi (CS): Question: do we include a live demo of onboarding? Eng infra needs scrubbed data. If yes, I'll record a short clip.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder: please upload any demo recordings to the shared drive by Tue 5pm.
Maya (CS): For "Ask from Execs" slide, suggested asks: approve 6-week concierge onboarding option, approve $40k partner funds to unblock SFTP, and a headcount for one Solutions Engineer for 6 months. Thoughts?
Lina (Finance): Put projected ROI for each ask (3- and 12-months). I'll help with the numbers.
Diego (Enablement): I'll include quotes: "we can't finish SFTP without an example manifest" + "need role play templates for CSMs". Will add sample playbook bullets.
Ravi (CS): Uploaded onboarding GIF and a small YAML snippet for SFTP tests to the doc. Also added a remediation path if SFTP slips.
Jo (CSM): I'll draft the renewal timeline slide with checkpoint owners at 90/60/30/14/7 days.
Maya (CS): Action list:
- Maya: stitch deck, narrative + one-line "why it matters" per slide
- Ravi: adoption slide + demo clip + integration status
- Jo: renewal timeline + churn signals
- Diego: enablement quotes + playbooks
- Lina: ROI numbers for asks
Everyone: drop final slide edits by Tue 4pm for dry run on Wed 9am.
Ravi (CS): Small note: hosting vs dedicated cost split requested by execs last time. I'll add a quick table (token economics + latency).
Maya (CS): Good call. Keep it one small table, not a deep dive. Execs want clear tradeoffs.
Jo (CSM): Pricing scenarios queued: conservative + aggressive. Will attach two-line rationale for each.
Diego (Enablement): Added two role templates to the doc. Also created a 1-page quick-start for SFTP.
Lina (Finance): Uploaded modeled numbers (attached). Scenario B shows break-even at month 5 with the concierge package.
Maya (CS): Thanks all. Rehearsal invite Wed 9:00 sent to deck owners. Bring 2 talking bullets and a possible Q&A response for the renewal ask. :thumbsup:
rehearsal-bot: Calendar invite created: Wed 09:00. Agenda: deck run-through (30m), objections & Q&A (20m), finalize asks (10m).
Jo (CSM): Will review slides tonight and flag any gaps.
Ravi (CS): FYI added a short perf stat line: p95 latency 220ms, token cost delta +3% on dedicated.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Final: please add a one-sentence "customer quote" where relevant. That helps exec empathy.
Diego (Enablement): Done.
Maya (CS): Closing the thread  will ping when master deck is uploaded for final 15-min review.
